directSourceFindings: The Stage 16 production gate consumes validateChangeTrace for every current changeset rather than accepting collection existence as proof.
Every confirmed defect identity must be included in the valid correction coverage set or Stage 16 remains incomplete.
A changeset whose old and new controlled version identities are equal is rejected as an in-place modification.
An instruction change without required repeated independent preflight is rejected.
An execution-only root cause that changes the production instruction is rejected and must preserve the correct instruction while rerunning execution.
verify-root-cause-correction.mjs executes the real production gate on isolated disposable project state and includes a repaired fixture that progresses.

Using distinct old and new controlled version identities satisfies controlled versioning.
Marking repeated preflight required for an instruction change restores instruction-change admissibility.
Preserving the instruction for an execution-only root cause and rerunning with a new execution identity restores progression.
